body: Clash at Demonhead is Vic Tokai's NES action adventure, starring special agent Billy 'Big Bang' Blitz. A kidnapped scientist and a doomsday weapon send him through a network of routes containing enemies, allies and unexpected diversions. Bang runs, jumps and fires a gun, but the map gives those familiar actions a more open structure. Junctions offer different destinations, and earlier areas can be revisited. The mission develops through encounters spread across that network, gradually explaining which person or object should be found next.

Shops offer weapons and equipment that help Bang manage the changing terrain. Later powers include flight, healing, shrinking and travel back to previously visited locations. These abilities give a practical reason to remember a difficult stretch rather than treat it as finished once passed. The world contains more than forty routes, making the choice of direction part of play. Some journeys advance the main mission; others provide the resources or information that make the next attempt more promising.

The story introduces a skeletal mastermind, a captured hermit and several unreliable acquaintances as Bang pursues the medallions associated with the bomb. Conversations change the meaning of places already visited and send the player toward another part of the map. Its humour comes partly from putting a confident action hero in situations he cannot solve merely by shooting. Released in Japan as Dengeki Big Bang!, the game uses a succession of eccentric meetings to give its open routes a reason to be followed.
